openQuestions.q: Should metadata-only validation reuse be represented as a new evidence artifact or as an extension to done-required-evidence.json? Current B-fbcf plan requires an explicit reuse record but does not settle the storage contract.
openQuestions.evidence: Legacy plan lists this as an Open Question; B-fbcf CHK-003 says preserve prior transcript and write an explicit metadata-only reuse record without naming the artifact/schema.
openQuestions.resolution: Resolved for B-fbcf: represent metadata-only validation reuse as an extension of done-required-evidence.json. The record must reference prior validation and DONE-required evidence, preserve prior command transcripts, and explicitly state validation was reused rather than rerun. It is not a new reviewer, host, delivery, fallback, Authority, release, or production evidence artifact.
